Agent Name: WebSurfer
, Step Number: 17
, Reason for Mistake: WebSurfer made a mistake by not accurately identifying the link or verifying the correct release version of the GFF3 file in earlier steps, leading to repeated navigation and search attempts without success. The error first occurred in step 17 when WebSurfer incorrectly focused on a more recent release (115) instead of the correct Ensembl release 102 for files around October 2020. This misidentification led to a series of loops and incorrect search attempts, delaying the correct identification of the needed file link.
